definitions.explanation: Reading without vocalizing the words, as opposed to reading aloud. Commonly used in educational settings.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{文章|ぶんしょう}→文章：02957_bunshou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{黙読|もくどく}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{図書館|としょかん}→図書館：00580_toshokan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{黙読|もくどく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦マナー→マナー：11139_manaa⟧だ。
examples.english: Reading silently is the proper etiquette in the library.

examples.japanese: ⟦{音読|おんどく}→音読：15825_ondoku⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{黙読|もくどく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{速|はや}く→速い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{読|よ}める→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: You can read faster with silent reading than reading aloud.

notes:
SIMILAR WORDS:
{黙読|もくどく} (silent reading) is the opposite of ⟦{音読|おんどく}→音読：15825_ondoku⟧ (reading aloud). In Japanese schools, both are practiced. ⟦{音読|おんどく}→音読：15825_ondoku⟧ is emphasized in language learning because it helps with pronunciation and retention, while {黙読|もくどく} is used for comprehension exercises.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {黙読|もくどく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to read silently)
- {黙読|もくどく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧ (to read by silent reading)
- {黙読|もくどく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧ (silent reading time)

WRITING:
{黙|もく} means silence, as in ⟦{沈黙|ちんもく}→沈黙：13249_chinmoku⟧ (silence). {読|どく} means reading.
